fields.label: Complex Data Type Reference Parsing

fields.label: Dataset
fields.help: Identifies the dataset addressed by this request.

fields.label: Default Search Handling Strict
fields.help: If true, overrides the default search behavior for this FHIR store to handling=strict which returns an error for unrecognized search parameters.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Disable Referential Integrity
fields.help: Whether to disable referential integrity in this FHIR store.

fields.label: Disable Resource Versioning
fields.help: Whether to disable resource versioning for this FHIR store.

fields.label: Enable History Import
fields.help: Whether to allow the bulk import API to accept history bundles and directly insert historical resource versions into the FHIR store.

fields.label: Enable Update Create
fields.help: Whether this FHIR store has the updateCreate capability.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The resource name for the FhirStore.

fields.label: Version
fields.help: The FHIR specification version.

fields.label: Notification Configs
Pubsub Topic
fields.help: The Cloud Pub/Sub topic that notifications of changes are published on.

fields.label: Send Full Resource
fields.help: Whether to send full FHIR resource to this Pub/Sub topic for Create and Update operation.

fields.label: Send Previous Resource On Delete
fields.help: Whether to send full FHIR resource to this Pub/Sub topic for deleting FHIR resource.
A list of notifcation configs that configure the notification for every resource mutation in this FHIR store.

fields.label: Stream Configs
Resource Types
fields.help: Supply a FHIR resource type (such as "Patient" or "Observation").

Dataset Uri
fields.help: BigQuery URI to a dataset, up to 2000 characters long, in the format bq://projectId.bqDatasetId

fields.label: Schema Config
Recursive Structure Depth
fields.help: The depth for all recursive structures in the output analytics schema.

fields.label: Schema Type
fields.help: Specifies the output schema type.

Expiration Ms

fields.help: Whether to disable reference type validation for incoming resources.
